C1455.title: Aztec Connect Legacy Contract Vulnerability Exploited for $2.1 Million
C1455.summary: A vulnerability in Aztec Connect's legacy contract, which was designed to be fully immutable with no upgrade capability, was exploited. As a result, a portion of the tokens became trapped in the non-upgradable contract and could not be withdrawn.
